_readme: Shared Scan outcomes (workers/scan-proxy/CONTEXT.md, 'Scan outcomes') - THIS FILE is the source of truth for what a Scan that does not deliver (or delivers less than everything) must tell the user and how a retry behaves, not either client. Web (web/src/scanOutcomes.test.ts) and Android (android/.../ui/ScanOutcomesFixtureTest.kt) each load it and check their own behaviour; when one disagrees, fix the client, or change the row here and the glossary entry together. One row per case. Fields: id; case (the number in the glossary table; 12 is split into a-d); appliesTo (clients that have the case); trigger (what happens, which each client maps onto its own harness: worker_error = the Worker answers with that status and code; no_connection; unreadable_reply = an answer that is not the Worker's; no_answer_in_time; unsendable_photo = the client cannot send the photo; no_service_address = web only; delivered = the Worker delivered fields, fieldsRead says how many of the screen's fields it filled; delivered_no_weight = a delivered stand-alone ticket answer with no weight); spent (was a Scan Credit taken: yes | no | unknown); refunded (yes | no | not_applicable); retryKeepsRequestId (does a retry of the same photo send the same client_request_id, true exactly when the answer to the last request is unknown or the Scan was charged and not refunded); offersTryAgain (is a 'Try again' offered); nextStep (the steps the user is offered, from: sign_in, buy_scans, try_again, choose_different_photo, type_it_in; typing the numbers in is always open, so type_it_in is listed only where the client offers it as a step); messageContains (phrases the message the user reads must contain, compared case-insensitively, so Web may say 'scan' where Android says 'Scan'; phrases, not whole sentences, so each client keeps its own punctuation and its own screen's field labels); pending (per client, the row fields not yet built there, each with the ticket that builds it; a pending field is not checked and is listed by the test; the Android or Web ticket that builds it removes it from the list). Checked by: Android checks every field, nextStep exactly. Web checks every field except nextStep, of which it checks only try_again, because Web's other steps are screens and gates, not a list. noticeFieldLists is the one rule for naming the fields a Scan did not read: join with ', ' and ' and ' (A, A and B, A, B and C) and end 'Type it in' for one field, 'Type them in' for more; the labels themselves are each screen's own and are never part of the fixture's sentences except here, where they are made up.
